messages:
olivia: Heads-up — multiple app-of-apps children stuck OutOfSync because a PostSync Job never finishes; prune wave is blocked and we're seeing GPU pool not scale. argocd shows HookFailed PostSync on several apps.

argocd-bot: Application 'ml-inference' sync failed: HookFailed post-sync job 'migrate-db' (hook phase: PostSync)

sam: Are nodes even provisioning? ran a quick check — `gcloud compute instance-groups list` shows no new instances for the gpu-pool. cluster-autoscaler logs?

kai: Checking CA logs: `ERROR: cannot patch instance group: permission denied (compute.instanceGroupManagers.update)` — looks like the autoscaler SA lost the compute.instanceAdmin binding after a terraform apply. I see a terraform diff removing modules/gke/iam google_project_iam_member.autoscaler.

anya: I ran `terraform plan` in infra/gke and indeed there's a change removing the autoscaler IAM binding. I didn't expect that; module default var changed. Pasting the diff:
```diff
- resource \"google_project_iam_member\" \"autoscaler\" {
-   role   = \"roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1\"
-   member = google_service_account.cluster-autoscaler.email
- }
```

ashley: Quick workaround if we need to unblock: annotate parent app with `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: SkipHooks=true` so prune can continue. But that will skip DB migrations — not great for prod.

sam: We should avoid SkipHooks in prod. Better: re-add the IAM binding so CA can scale, and in parallel fix the Helm post-sync Job which has `backoffLimit: 10` causing long retry loops. If CA takes long, job retries amplify the outage. Suggest patching chart values to `backoffLimit: 1` temporarily.

mateo: Also noticed GPU nodes eventually started but driver DaemonSet is failing to schedule pods on them — tolerations mismatch. Previously taint key was `nvidia.com/gpu`, but the node template now applies `gpu.redwood.com/gpu`. DS tolerations need to be updated in the helm chart.

olivia: Plan: 1) Reapply IAM binding (PR opened: infra/gke #3124) 2) Patch helm values in staging to set `backoffLimit: 1` and update tolerations (PR #3125) 3) Once GPU nodes are ready, re-run migrations manually if needed. Anyone object?

anya: :thumbsup: I'll approve both PRs and validate TF state after #3124 lands.

kai: I'll monitor cluster-autoscaler and ArgoCD sync. If argocd still refuses to progress after nodes are healthy, I'll run `kubectl patch app ml-inference -n argocd --type merge -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options":"SkipHooks=true"}}}'` for a short window and re-enable immediately after.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: apply finished for infra/gke #3124 — google_project_iam_member.autoscaler created

olivia: Update — autoscaler started provisioning instances and CA logs show `scale up` events, GPU nodes are coming up. I patched tolerations in staging chart; driver DS now scheduling. PostSync job retried and succeeded. ArgoCD reported sync complete at 1785004989.

sam: Good catch on the TF var drift + helm backoff. We should add a preflight check in our infra CI to detect removal of autoscaler bindings and a lint rule that flags changes to taint keys.

mateo: I'll open an infra ticket to add a TF sentinel in the pipeline and a helm value guard.

olivia: Thanks all — keeping this thread for postmortem notes. If you hit similar drift tag me. Final quick commands used: `kubectl get pods -n argocd -o wide`, `kubectl logs -n kube-system cluster-autoscaler-xx`, `terraform plan -var-file=staging.tfvars`.

(End of thread)
